definitions.de: Festziehen, straff binden oder zusammendrücken; etwas fest umschließen oder einschnüren
definitions.en: To tighten, bind, or squeeze; to fasten or cinch something firmly around something else
definitions.es: Apretar, atar o exprimir; sujetar o ceñir algo firmemente alrededor de algo
definitions.fr: Serrer, attacher ou presser; fixer ou sangler quelque chose fermement autour de quelque chose
definitions.hi: कसना, बांधना या दबाना; किसी चीज़ को किसी दूसरी चीज़ के चारों ओर मजबूती से कसना
definitions.ja: 締める、縛る、または絞る；何かをしっかりと固定したり締め付けたりする
definitions.km: ខ្សត់ ចងឬបញ្ចុះ; ចងឬបិទជ្រុងអ្វីមួយឱ្យជាប់
definitions.ko: 조이다, 묶다, 또는 꽉 잡다; 무언가를 단단히 고정하거나 졸라매다
definitions.ne: कस्नु, बाँध्नु वा निचोर्नु; कुनै चीज वरिपरि कडाइले बाँध्नु
definitions.pt: Apertar, amarrar ou comprimir; prender ou cingir algo firmemente ao redor de algo
definitions.th: รัด ผูก หรือบีบ; มัดหรือรัดสิ่งใดสิ่งหนึ่งอย่างแน่นหนา
definitions.tl: Higpitan, itali, o pisilin; ikabit o bigkisin nang mahigpit ang isang bagay
definitions.ur: کسنا، باندھنا یا نچوڑنا؛ کسی چیز کو مضبوطی سے کسی اور چیز کے گرد باندھنا
definitions.vi: Siết chặt, buộc, hoặc bóp; thắt hoặc cột chặt thứ gì đó quanh thứ khác
definitions.zh: 收紧、捆绑或挤压；将某物紧紧固定或扎紧在另一物周围
definitions.zh_Hant: 收緊、捆綁或擠壓；將某物緊緊固定或扎緊在另一物周圍

definition_en: To tighten, bind, or squeeze; to fasten or cinch something firmly around something else

lao_examples.translation_en: Tighten your belt a little more.

lao_examples.lao_script: ຮັດເຊືອກໃຫ້ດີ ຢ່າໃຫ້ຫຼຸດ
lao_examples.romanization: hat suea hai di, ya hai lud
lao_examples.translation_en: Tie the rope tightly so it doesn't come undone.
